One case per code in keenable-backend-ts docs/error-catalog.json (error format v1: type, code, fix, docs_url and retryable from the catalog; error and message are its title and summary, which a route may word differently, and SDKs never parse them), with the domain extras of the "before v1" case of the same code. The "(before v1)" cases are bodies older servers send, without type; expect.type is what an SDK derives from the status and code. Kept identical in go/testdata, python/tests/fixtures and typescript/test/fixtures.
